title: New y position
prompt: The robot jumps. It has a vertical position y and a vertical speed vy in pixels per second, where down is positive. Return the new y after one frame. The starter forgets delta and moves a whole second per frame.
starter:
func solve(y, vy, delta) -> float:
	return y + vy

tests.name: From 0 at 100 down for 0.1 s is 10

hints: Speed must be scaled by delta before adding it.
solution:
func solve(y, vy, delta) -> float:
	return y + vy * delta
